input._script:
using JSON3
result = Dict{String,Any}("hostname" => gethostname())
println(stderr, "NODE: ", gethostname()); flush(stderr)
f = joinpath(mktempdir(), "diag.sh")
write(f, raw"""
set +e
echo "== LD_LIBRARY_PATH entries"; echo "$LD_LIBRARY_PATH" | tr ':' '\n'
source /scratch/coop/drozda/jax-env/bin/activate
SP=$(python -c "import site;print(site.getsitepackages()[0])")
echo "== site-packages: $SP"
echo "== nvidia dirs"; ls $SP/nvidia 2>&1 | tr '\n' ' '; echo
echo "== cusparse / nvjitlink libs"; ls $SP/nvidia/cusparse/lib $SP/nvidia/nvjitlink/lib 2>&1
echo "== ldd libcusparse (as-is env)"; ldd $SP/nvidia/cusparse/lib/libcusparse.so.12 2>&1 | head -12
echo "== CUDA libs found through LD_LIBRARY_PATH (these shadow the pip libs)"
for l in libcusparse.so.12 libnvJitLink.so.12 libcublas.so.12 libcublasLt.so.12 libcudnn.so.9 libcusolver.so.11 libcufft.so.11 libcudart.so.12; do
  for d in $(echo "$LD_LIBRARY_PATH" | tr ':' ' '); do [ -e "$d/$l" ] && echo "$l <- $d"; done
done
PIPLIBS=$(ls -d $SP/nvidia/*/lib 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ':')
T='import jax; print("BACKEND", jax.default_backend(), [str(d) for d in jax.devices()])'
echo "== test A: as-is"; python -c "$T" 2>&1 | grep -E "BACKEND|not found|Falling|Error" | head -4
echo "== test B: LD_LIBRARY_PATH unset"; env -u LD_LIBRARY_PATH python -c "$T" 2>&1 | grep -E "BACKEND|not found|Falling|Error" | head -4
echo "== test C: pip lib dirs first, rest kept"; LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$PIPLIBS$LD_LIBRARY_PATH" python -c "$T" 2>&1 | grep -E "BACKEND|not found|Falling|Error" | head -4
echo "== test D: pip lib dirs only"; LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$PIPLIBS" python -c "$T" 2>&1 | grep -E "BACKEND|not found|Falling|Error" | head -4
""")
try
    out = IOBuffer(); err = IOBuffer()
    p = run(pipeline(ignorestatus(`bash $f`), stdout=out, stderr=err))
    result["exit"] = p.exitcode
    result["diag"] = String(take!(out))
    result["stderr_tail"] = let s = String(take!(err)); s[max(1,end-800):end] end
catch e
    result["error"] = sprint(showerror, e)
end
println(JSON3.write(result))
